name: OWASP_A03_SQL_Injection_Attempt
search: index=web_logs sourcetype="access_combined" | eval decoded_payload=urldecode(_raw) | regex decoded_payload="(?i)(\bUNION\b.*\bSELECT\b|\bSELECT\b.*\bFROM\b|\bINSERT\b.*\bINTO\b|\bSLEEP\(\d+\)|\bBENCHMARK\(\d+|\bWAITFOR\b\s+\bDELAY\b|' OR '1'='1|--\s*$|\bAND\b\s+\d+=\d+)" | stats count values(uri_path) as attacked_endpoints values(decoded_payload) as sample_payload by src_ip, http_user_agent, status
description: OWASP A03: SQL Injection yuklerini ve hucum cehdlerini tespit eder.
